strings.en: Here I come. Are you prepared?
I show no mercy to my enemies.
Since you've come forward, I'll assume you're prepared.
Allow me to take the first move.
You've stepped out before me. How brave of you.
As a knight, I shall fight with no shame.
You will accept my challenge.
I won't underestimate you people.
The skill and pride I've honed.../　I shall wield them to the fullest.
I won't let you go any further.
I won't let you into Gaw-La.
A fine chance to dispose of a counterfeit.
I can't overlook a counterfeit.
If only you and Al-Van had never met...
You too are tied to the Fury's future.../　Though you don't realize it.
Boy... I won't let you leave Gaw-La.
Combining is the will of a god?/　I refuse to accept that.
Your Highness, I...
For Lord Gu-Landon's sake, I...
Your Highness... you have no right/　to lead the people of the Fury.
Boy... take the full weight of my resolve...!
With everything I have, this time the Throne Unit...!
That machine no longer has a reason to exist.
No matter how it's enhanced,/　a counterfeit can never surpass a knight's unit.
Show me how far you can go with a counterfeit.
An interesting existence, but...
Like a flying armory./　But it's no match for a knight's unit.
That counterfeit lacks elegance.
Ice-clad Vaula... you and I are fated to fight.
To think Vaula would stand alongside humans...
The machine that broke Larseilam.../　I can't leave it be.
Can that great blade cut me down?
A fierce armored warrior.../　A worthy opponent for a knight.
That huge body can never catch me.
The sturdier it is, the more worth breaking...
Size alone won't give you the advantage.
I'll return the favor.
Now, regret it.
Accept the consequences you brought on yourself.
I'll come to you, then.
That was careless of you.
Still there...? How dutiful.
Allow me to strike as well.
Respect and defeat to the strong...
Ngh! Splendid...!!
You surpassed... my resolve...?!
I see... So this is the outcome...
This is battle./　I'm bound to be wounded too...!
Not bad. That's more like it!
The truly strong turn even hardship into strength...!
Wonderful! To drive me this far!
Victory and defeat are a hair apart.../　but the same holds for my foe.
Now, come at me once more!/　I'll give you my blessing!
To drive my Fauneia this far...!
Lady Shana-Mia... your existence is...!
Your fighting spirit... I can feel it/　even without the Cytron System.
Ngh! Is this the work/　of the Shune blood...?!
I refuse to accept that this/　is Fureim's will...!!
Your skill, fighting this well in a counterfeit.../　I'll grant you that.
My Fauneia, overwhelmed by a counterfeit...!
That power... No wonder it helped/　bring about Vaula's sealing...!
If I could obtain that machine's technology,/　Larseilam would...!
Ngh! That power, that great blade.../　It's a threat even in single combat...!
Hesitation will lead to your death, you know?
Heh... You seem a worthy opponent for me.
That's right! If you don't want to die, fight back!
Not enough yet.
That blow is far from deciding anything.
Throwing me off balance even for a moment.../　I'll give you credit for that.
My Fauneia is no easy opponent.
Is this blow also the will/　of Her Highness...?
What will my choice bring about...?/　I shall see it through.
Ngh, that much power, even with the boy piloting...
The Blade of the Imperial Family indeed.../　Not an easy opponent.
How deft. Keeping up with me in a counterfeit...
To think the Bellzelute could fight/　evenly with a Raftclans...
Not bad, that counterfeit...!
I can't let my guard down/　against that counterfeit's firepower...!
Vaula's power is intact... Then!
I cannot overlook anyone who would/　enter the Stasis Field...!
The Dygenguar is not to be taken lightly after all...!
Surely one scratch doesn't satisfy you?
Don't underestimate me.
Your resolve is lacking. Don't disappoint me.
Is this the extent of your fighting spirit?
There's no need for games.
Is that composure?/　Either you're very strong, or a fool... Which is it?
Just catching the Fauneia is all you can manage.
My resolve... is not so light, boy!
Nimble, and therefore weak.
You can't draw out the Throne Unit's full power.
Even with the Basileus,/　is that all the power you can muster?
Its mobility is higher/　than the old Bellzelute's.
A weak counterfeit, despite its looks.
Weak or not, I can't overlook that machine.
What are you playing at, Vaula?
It means there are things even you cannot cut.
Such scattered aim.
Aim more carefully.
Haven't you the resolve to hit me?
My Fauneia, by something like that...
I told you I'm serious too, boy!
You don't hesitate, do you, boy?
Your Highness... you must know full well/　a knight's power.
I can't fall behind a counterfeit.
The Throne Unit's power isn't meant/　to be used blindly.
What's wrong? Don't you want to defeat me?
Is this the extent of your resolve?
There's no shame in it. The one before you/　is a knight of the Fury, after all.
That has no effect.
Heh, you keep coming, never learning.
Think of another approach.
Unable to strike... How lucky for you.
I'll let you go.
You've been spared, it seems.
You seem to know how to fight.
You've shown me an opening.
One more blow... Allow me to push through.
Jua-Mu, leave the follow-up to me.
I shall cover you.
The Fauneia can withstand this.
Stand back, Jua-Mu.
If you want relief, just fall!
Take this!
Can you keep up with the Fauneia's speed?
Claw, deploy!
From that position, this will do.
Orgone Claw...!
Caught you!
You shan't escape!
Over here!
I'll take you all in one sweep!
Fall together, into the darkness of Voda!
Orgone Materialization...!
No need to be afraid. Honor remains after death.
This sword is proof of my resolve!
It cannot be stopped!
Now, imagine it!
The repose of true death!
Busker Mode, activate.
Orgonite Mirage!
Busker Mode!
Ride on, Fauneia!
I'll put you out of your misery!
This is your coffin...
I'll guide you to eternal rest!
Sleep in the abyss of Voda!
You're mine!
You can't move anymore.
Burn it into your eyes!
The form of the one who brings your defeat!
